content.text:
Yes, verification finished successfully. Your Google account is connected using the existing ghealth CLI credentials, and a read-only API request (`users.getIdentity`) confirmed it works.

**Permissions granted (all read-only, none denied):**
- Activity and fitness
- ECG
- Health metrics and measurements
- IRN
- Location
- Logged symptoms
- Mindfulness
- Nutrition
- Profile
- Reproductive health
- Settings
- Sleep

**Limitations:**
- Because the consent screen is in Testing mode, refresh tokens expire after 7 days. When that happens, run `ghealth auth login` and the connection will pick up the new credentials.
- No data has been imported yet. The connection only verifies access. If you want history pulled into the local database, I can start an import next.
